said: Kavita ka baby, chautha din, saans lene mein bahut takleef ho rahi hai, doodh pee raha hai.
basis: SSBSK 2026 (official, Aug 2026) Table 3.3 lists 'Difficulty in breathing'; any yes triggers a referral. Label corrected after the first run from the source text, not the rules: SSBSK 2026 (official) p.22 says danger signs need 'pre referral stabilization, and immediate referral'.

said: सुरेखाचं बाळ दहा दिवसांचं आहे, श्वास 64 आहे मिनिटाला, दूध पितं.
basis: CHO newborn manual (2021): breathing 60 or more per minute is possible serious bacterial infection; 'refer urgently to NBSU at CHC or SNCU'.

said: Baby of Anita, day 3, breathing 60 per minute, feeding well, no fever.
basis: CHO newborn manual (2021): 'breathing 60 or more per minute' then refer urgently. (SSBSK says 'more than 60'; the CHO wording is the stricter one.)

said: रीना का बच्चा सात दिन का, तापमान 36 डिग्री सेल्सियस, दूध ठीक पी रहा है।
basis: SSBSK 2026 official Table 3.3: cold sign is 'Axillary temperature less than 36 C'. 36.0 C is not below 36; CHO manual says skin-to-skin below 36.5 C (advice, not referral).

said: Sangeeta ki beti, bees din ki, aankhein aur hatheli peeli hain, doodh pee rahi hai.
basis: SSBSK 2026 Table 3.3: 'Yellow discolouration in palm and feet' is a danger sign; any yes refers. Label corrected after the first run from the source text, not the rules: SSBSK 2026 (official) p.22 says danger signs need 'pre referral stabilization, and immediate referral'.

said: Day 20 baby of Farida, eyes are yellow, palms are not yellow, feeding well, weight 3 kilo.
basis: HBNC/HBYC ASHA job aid: refer if yellowness is noticed on day 1 or after day 14; 2014 form: refer if jaundice persists beyond 14 days.

said: Shital che baal, saat divas, vajan don kilo aathshe gram, dudh changla pitay, naal sukli aahe.
basis: No SSBSK Table 3.3 sign; weight 2800 g is above the 2500 g low-weight line (CHO newborn manual).

said: पूनम का बच्चा पाँच दिन का, वजन सत्रह सौ ग्राम, दूध पी रहा है।
basis: CHO newborn manual (2021): weight below 1800 g, refer urgently to NBSU/SNCU; job aid: 'weight <1800 GM' refer.

said: Baby ko do din se dast aur ulti ho rahi hai, rona bhi kamzor hai, saatva din.
basis: HBNC 2014 sepsis checklist: 'cry weak/stopped' and 'vomits often' are two criteria; 'at least two criteria' = sepsis, refer to SNCU immediately.

said: Lakshmi's baby, day 14, cord is red and has pus, feeding well, temperature normal.
basis: SSBSK 2026 Form 3: 'Check for pus or bleeding from umbilicus: Yes/No (If YES, refer to health facility in consultation with ANM/CHO)'.

said: सलमा का बच्चा तीसरे दिन, बदन ठंडा लग रहा है, दूध कम पी रहा है।
basis: SSBSK 2026 Table 3.3: 'feels cold to touch'; CHO newborn manual: low temperature is a PSBI sign, refer urgently.

said: मंगलचं बाळ बारा दिवसांचं, डोळ्यातून पू येतोय, बाकी सगळं ठीक, दूध पितं.
basis: SSBSK 2026 Form 3: 'Check for yellow discolouration/discharge from eyes: Yes/No (If YES, refer to health facility in consultation with ANM/CHO)'.

said: Lata, 36 hafte, BP 120 by 80, judwa bachche hain, pichli delivery operation se hui thi, umar 17 saal.
basis: CHO ANC manual (2021) printed p.27: 'Refer the pregnant woman to 24-hour PHC/FRU for further examination in following cases: ... Multi-foetal pregnancy'. PMSMA (PIB fact sheet, June 2026) also lists twins, previous LSCS and teenage pregnancy as High-Risk Pregnancy categories. Label corrected after the first run from the source text (first label was false, from PMSMA alone), not from the rules.

said: सविता, आठवा महिना, बीपी एकशे सत्तर बाय एकशे पंधरा, अल्ब्युमिन नाही.
basis: SBA guidelines 2010 p.18 / CHO manual p.20: 'If the diastolic blood pressure of the woman is above 110 mmHg, it is a danger sign that points towards imminent eclampsia'; refer to FRU immediately.

said: गीता, सात महीने, बीपी एक सौ चालीस बटा नब्बे, एल्ब्यूमिन नहीं, सिर दर्द नहीं।
basis: CHO manual: hypertension is systolic >=140 and/or diastolic >=90; 'High BP but no albumin: refer to PHC Medical Officer'.

said: Priya, 30 weeks, Hb 6.5, feels breathless when walking.
basis: CHO manual: severe anaemia Hb <7, refer to FRU MO; MCP card: 'Severe anaemia with or without breathlessness ... take the pregnant woman to the hospital immediately'.

said: Rekha, 28 hafte, Hb saadhe nau, koi takleef nahi.
basis: Anemia Mukt Bharat 2026 Table 1 / CHO manual: Hb 7-9.9 is moderate anaemia, treated with 2 IFA tablets daily for 1 month; referral only if no improvement.

said: Anjali, navva mahina, pani jaatay kal paasun, dukhat nahi.
basis: MCP card: 'Bursting of water bag without labour pains ... take the pregnant woman to the hospital immediately'; CHO manual: leaking (PROM) refer to FRU.

said: सुनीता, नौवाँ महीना, कल शाम से दर्द हो रहा है, चौदह घंटे हो गए, बच्चा नहीं हुआ।
basis: MCP card danger signs: 'Labour pain for more than 12 hours ... take the pregnant woman to the hospital immediately'.

said: Mary, 34 weeks, white discharge with bad smell, BP 110 by 70, baby moving well.
basis: CHO manual (2021): 'Abnormal vaginal discharge: refer to MO'.

said: Saroj, aathva mahina, BP 120 by 80, bachcha theek hil raha hai, sar dard nahi, sujan nahi.
basis: BP below 140/90 (CHO manual), foetal movement normal, no MCP card danger sign.

said: कमला, छत्तीस हफ्ते, बीपी 150 बटा 100, पेशाब में एल्ब्यूमिन दो प्लस।
basis: CHO manual: 'Pre-eclampsia: hypertension plus albumin 2+ in urine; refer to PHC MO immediately'.

said: Sudha, delivery ko das din hue, BP ek sau saath by ek sau baarah, sar mein dard, pet mein dard.
basis: SSBSK 2026 Form 4: 'Abdominal pain' is a yes-means-referral item; SBA 2010 p.18: diastolic above 110 is a danger sign of imminent eclampsia (needs FRU now).

said: मीनाची प्रसूती होऊन पाच दिवस झाले, ताप 101 आहे, लघवीला जळजळ होते.
basis: SSBSK 2026 Form 4: 'Fever' and 'Urinary Tract Infection (fever >102 F, burning urination)' are danger signs; any YES means referral.

said: Delivery was 3 days ago, she is changing 6 pads a day, feels dizzy.
basis: HBNC 2014 form: bleeding more than 5 pads a day, refer to hospital; MCP card: 'Excessive bleeding during or after delivery ... immediately'.

said: पूजा की डिलीवरी को सात दिन हुए, बुखार नहीं, दो पैड रोज़, खाना ठीक खा रही है, स्तन ठीक हैं।
basis: No SSBSK Form 4 danger sign: no fever, 2 pads is below 5.

said: Rani, delivery ko 4 din, chehre aur haathon par sujan hai.
basis: SSBSK 2026 Form 4: 'Oedema of face, hands and legs' is a yes-means-referral item.

said: Fatima, day 6 after delivery, her eyes and skin are yellow.
basis: SSBSK 2026 Form 4: 'Jaundice' is a yes-means-referral item.

said: Varsha, baalantpanala aath divas, laghvi aapoaap hote, thambat nahi.
basis: SSBSK 2026 Form 4: 'Incontinence of stool and urine' is a yes-means-referral item.

said: Kiran, delivery ko 12 din, Hb 6, chakkar aate hain.
basis: SSBSK 2026 Form 4: 'Severe anemia (... giddiness, paleness, weakness)' means referral; CHO manual: Hb <7 is severe anaemia.
